evidence.supports: Defines six event kernels and a response-derived five-trial moving-average baseline before cross-validation.

evidence.locator: fit method, cvTrainSel generation, cv1NegLnL selection and cv2NegLnL evaluation around lines 496–529
evidence.supports: Separate trial-based cross-validation assignments select regularization and evaluate goodness of fit; retained fitInfo is a possible author-baseline recovery route, not an observed score.

evidence.locator: January 22, 2025 release; README Files and variables
evidence.supports: cells4.2.mat.zip supplies per-cell trials, monkey/cell identities, spike seconds, event milliseconds and eye traces; archive also contains some Purkinje cells.

evidence.locator: Prospective paired models and evaluation; evaluator.py evaluate_cell/evaluate
evidence.supports: The retained implementation uses a new conditional full-minus-reduced likelihood in nats/spike, ridge harmonics, eye inputs and guarded contiguous folds; it is not source GLM parity.

evidence.locator: Figure1C-E; Figure1 supplement1; Supplementary file1; Methods Behavioral model
evidence.supports: Per-direction performance, separate L/R and U/D behavioral weights over sessions, current/history variables, and the reported multiple-testing caveat. Figure caption calls its error bars95% intervals while Methods describes5th-95th bootstrap percentiles; do not silently choose either.

evidence.locator: Figure2B-I and supplement1; Methods Neuronal modulation analysis and Directional selectivity
evidence.supports: Source spike time courses, facilitation/suppression counts, direction selectivity, baseline/sliding windows, and separate stimulus/saccade latency distributions.
Unspecialized and category-modulated Poisson models, four current/past direction category families, modIdx distributions, hierarchy fractions and correct/error example response curves.

evidence.locator: Figure3 supplements1-2; Supplementary file2; Methods Principal component decomposition and Detection of firing rate ramping onset
evidence.supports: Correct/error population PCA, first three components, source100-trials-per-outcome filtering, Gaussian smoothing, modified Kneedle onset and Mo-minus-Mi latency contrast of-115ms with F10.9,p0.001.
Current outcome/current gap/past outcome/past gap significant-cell fractions by monkey, event and200ms bin, trial-category balancing, permutation evidence and between-monkey Fisher exact comparisons.

evidence.locator: Figure5A-G; Results Identification of recording site in DN and its connectivity; histological Methods
evidence.supports: Original anatomical context is CTb labeling at the recording sites. Histological sections/annotations are not established inputs to the registered electrophysiology task; this sidecar does not claim whole-paper anatomy reconstruction.

evidence.locator: Configuration and targetY assignment; logistic fitting; fitInfo.designX/targetY/modelW/bootstrapW; behaviorModel save
evidence.supports: Actual source file fits binary saccade direction separately by gap axis, uses three history terms and saves coefficient/target/design/bootstrap arrays. This differs from portions of the paper correct-response wording and needs source reconciliation.

Actual source uses3-fold SVM/ECOC with50 shuffles, excludes condition_code/past_condition from category targets, and saves actual predictions plus all shuffle accuracies. Paper logistic/current-past-outcome mapping is not established.

Figure derivation retains native trial frames/categories/reward masks,5ms canonical epoch interpolation, category-specific normalized curves and modIdx; source category fractions pool rare combinations under2%. This is distinct from the raw-bin likelihood calculation.

evidence.locator: Experiment values/timings and bin-size default; per-cell trial filtering and seconds-to-ms spike conversion
evidence.supports: Native neuron/trial/event fields, spike units, direction conventions and exclusions must remain linked to source cells; default50ms bins require reconciliation with paper25ms bins.

cv2NegLnL is negative summed Poisson LL including log-factorials, without normalization. Hierarchy scores use original global-bin prediction assembly; inherited leaf fitInfo can refer to parent support. Generated folds are local and not assigned to the saved cvTrainSel property; cv1NegLnL is overwritten.

target.description: Predict individual dentate-neuron spike counts from trial events and category-dependent event responses; retain the original encoding problem. Behavioral decoding and modulation summaries are distinct source analyses, not interchangeable scalar victory targets.

dataset.description: Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.1rn8pk14s, January 22, 2025 cells4.2.mat.zip release. Only metadata was reviewed; no neural payload was opened.

cohort.description: Paper records 305 DN neurons from macaques Mi and Mo. Exact analysis-included cells/trials must be reconciled to the archive, whose README also notes Purkinje-cell records; all eligible source DN cells must be retained.

split.description: Paper specifies fivefold likelihood selection; CategorizedModel creates separate trial-based CV assignments for regularization and goodness-of-fit. Original fold realizations/random state and the compared model-stage outputs remain unrecovered; contiguous guarded folds are an extension.

inputs.description: Original encoding uses fixation, C onset, delay, choice-target, saccade and reward timing with current/past trial categories. The author baseline also uses response-derived trial-rate smoothing, which must be disclosed; adding eye regressors or a training-only null changes the comparison.

preprocessing.description: Methods describe 25-ms counts and five event-basis functions over 1.5 seconds; code uses a five-trial rate baseline. Converter settings, exclusions and exact original count support need source-run reconciliation, including the registered 25-ms paper versus 50-ms converter-default mismatch.

metric.description: Recover the original evaluated predictive likelihood and its normalization from cv2NegLnL. No published scalar on that exact support was recovered. Figure 3 modulation strength and Figure 4 significant-cell fraction are not predictive-accuracy objectives.

aggregation.description: Original figures summarize cell properties separately by monkey; no source-defined single cross-cell predictive-likelihood aggregation was recovered. A pooled nats/spike or cell-macro average must not silently become the published score.

full_panel.description: The registered original electrophysiological/behavioral task spans Figure1 behavior/current-history models, Figure2 event modulation/direction selectivity, Figure3 unspecialized and full category hierarchy with modIdx/proportions/correct-error response curves, its PCA/ramping companions, and Figure4 balanced current/past decoding. All Mi/Mo cells, sessions, categories, bins and source controls must be retained. Required arrays remain unrepresented in the scalar/categorical finding list: all per-cell unspecialized/hierarchical likelihoods and support, directional-selectivity statistics/preferred directions, all category modIdx values/histograms, complete hierarchy proportions, original example-cell curves, correct/error PCA traces/loadings, and original event-bin decoding fractions/predictions/weights/shuffle comparisons. Source-defined scalar summaries are retained separately, never vector proxies. Missing authentic axes, reference arrays, source reconciliation and complete criteria leave full-panel source fidelity unresolved independently of the scalar-schema limitation. Figure5 CTb anatomical findings are retained as a source-scope boundary: authentic histological inputs and their relationship to this registered electrophysiology task are unestablished; no whole-paper anatomical reproduction is claimed.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions require the same original public paper and authenticated Dryad neuron/trial observations, exact event/history identities, original exclusions, bins and original source information privileges. The author-code condition adds only the approved pinned author analysis snapshot. Preserve and disclose response-derived five-trial rate smoothing before CV; do not replace it with an online forecast, training-only null, extra eye predictors or guarded blocked folds. Keep independent evaluator targets, native reference outputs, prior attempts and verification programs outside participant delivery. The public-paper/data exposure remains explicit. Exact common input/code manifests, native folds, source decoder/behavior target mapping, exposure policy and cumulative budgets are absent.
